name: study-reader
description: Open .study course format + KOReader plugin for active study on e-readers

scripts.plugin:check: cd packages/koreader-plugin && luajit -e "for _, f in ipairs({'_meta','main','md2xhtml','quiz','review','screens','srs','state','store'}) do assert(loadfile('plugin/studyreader.koplugin/' .. f .. '.lua'), f) end print('lua syntax OK')"
